config.heading: What our strategic workforce planning consulting delivers.
config.description: One connected program, from workforce strategy to a living plan. Not a deck and a hand-off: at each step we show what we do, what we build with you, and the deliverable you keep, layer by layer.

steps.title: Demand forecast
steps.how: Demand modeling benchmarked on our Capability Intelligence Platform.
do: Model the future roles, skills and headcount the strategy needs
Translate the business plan into workforce demand
Factor in growth, attrition and new capabilities
Build scenarios for different strategic paths

Headcount and capability projections

steps.how: Skills-gap analysis benchmarked on our Capability Intelligence Platform.
do: Map the workforce you have today, by role and skill
Project supply forward with attrition and movement
Compare supply against demand to size each gap
Prioritize the gaps that put the strategy at risk

The shortfall quantified, role by role

config.heading: Ready for strategic workforce planning that gets ahead of the gaps?

items.question: What does strategic workforce planning consulting include?
items.answer: It covers your workforce strategy and talent planning, demand forecasting, workforce analytics, supply and skills gap analysis, scenario planning, and the build, buy and borrow action plan and metrics that close the gaps, all aligned to the business goals.

items.question: How is this different from headcount budgeting?
items.answer: Headcount budgeting counts the roles you can afford this year. Strategic workforce planning forecasts the roles and skills the strategy will need, sizes the gaps against today's workforce, and plans how to close them, so your talent strategy follows the business strategy, not just the budget.

items.question: How far ahead does workforce planning look?
items.answer: Typically a three to five year horizon for the strategy, refreshed on a regular rhythm, because the plan and its capacity planning have to stay current as the business and labor market shift.

items.question: Do you help close the gaps, not just find them?
items.answer: Yes. The build, buy and borrow action plan, and the hiring, development and sourcing moves that execute it, are the core of the engagement, so analysis leads to filled roles.

items.question: What do we get at the end?
items.answer: A workforce strategy, a demand forecast, a supply and gap analysis, a build-buy-borrow action plan and the workforce metrics you own and run.
